UC-810.en: Always allow this exact command in {folder}.
UC-810.hi: {folder} में ठीक यही कमांड हमेशा चलने दें।
UC-810.hi_by: always_core words (provisional; Hindi-speaking lawyer to review)
UC-810.note: the approval card's Always for this matter option on a command, for Claude or ChatGPT. {folder} is the working folder relative to the matter ("Drafts"), or "this matter's folder" at its top. Clauseo keeps the command text byte for byte, with its folder for ChatGPT, and answers the same command there later

UC-811.en: Always allow changes to files in this matter.
UC-811.hi: इस मामले की फ़ाइलों में बदलाव हमेशा करने दें।
UC-811.hi_by: always_core words (provisional; Hindi-speaking lawyer to review)
UC-811.note: the approval card's Always for this matter option on a file edit, for Claude or ChatGPT. Clauseo keeps one rule (Edit(*)) that covers every file inside the matter folder, never a file outside it or in .clauseo or .claude

UC-812.hi: इस मामले में {site} को हमेशा अनुमति दें।
UC-812.hi_by: always_core words (provisional; Hindi-speaking lawyer to review)
UC-812.note: the approval card's Always for this matter option on a web page (Claude's WebFetch, or a network card). {site} is the exact host, and the rule covers every page on it

UC-813.en: Clauseo couldn't save this, so it applies only until Clauseo closes.
UC-813.hi: Clauseo इसे सहेज नहीं सका, इसलिए यह सिर्फ़ Clauseo बंद होने तक लागू रहेगा।
UC-813.hi_by: always_core words (provisional; Hindi-speaking lawyer to review)
UC-813.note: thread notice after the lawyer chose Always for this matter and the write to the matter's kept list failed. The rule holds in memory until Clauseo quits. With no secret store at all the card offers no Always, so this line doesn't show then

UC-814.hi: अनुमति दी गई: इस मामले के लिए हमेशा।
UC-814.hi_by: always_core words (provisional; Hindi-speaking lawyer to review)
UC-814.note: the thread's line where a card would have been: Clauseo answered the request itself, once, from a rule the lawyer kept for this matter

UC-815.en: You said no to this before. {agent} asked again, so Clauseo said no for you.
UC-815.hi: आपने पहले इसके लिए मना किया था। {agent} ने फिर पूछा, इसलिए Clauseo ने आपकी ओर से मना कर दिया।
UC-815.hi_by: always_core words (provisional; Hindi-speaking lawyer to review)
UC-815.note: the thread's line when the lawyer's earlier No holds and Clauseo refuses a repeat request without a card. {agent} is Claude or ChatGPT

UC-816.en: Nothing is always allowed in this matter yet.
UC-816.hi: इस मामले में अभी तक कुछ भी हमेशा के लिए अनुमत नहीं है।
UC-816.hi_by: always_core words (provisional; Hindi-speaking lawyer to review)
UC-816.note: Replaces UC-505: the empty Kept permissions list, now for both agents

UC-817.hi_by: always_core words (provisional; Hindi-speaking lawyer to review)
UC-817.note: the card's label for an agent's own session-only option (ChatGPT MCP allow_session, sent as clauseo.session:<id>). It lasts until the conversation ends and Clauseo keeps nothing

UC-818.en: In this matter, Clauseo allows these without asking. You chose "Always for this matter" for each.
UC-818.hi: इस मामले में Clauseo इन्हें बिना पूछे अनुमति देता है। हर एक के लिए आपने "इस मामले के लिए हमेशा" चुना था।
UC-818.hi_by: always_core words (provisional; Hindi-speaking lawyer to review)
UC-818.note: Replaces UC-502: the line under the Kept permissions title. Names Clauseo instead of Claude, since Clauseo answers for both agents

UC-819.en: Run: {command} / Run: {command} in {folder} / Change any file in this matter / Read: {file} / Any page on {site} / Use tool: {server} {tool} / Search the web
UC-819.hi: चलाना: {command} / चलाना: {command}, {folder} में / इस मामले की कोई भी फ़ाइल बदलना / पढ़ना: {file} / {site} का कोई भी पेज / टूल का इस्तेमाल: {server} {tool} / वेब पर खोज
UC-819.hi_by: always_core words (provisional; Hindi-speaking lawyer to review)
UC-819.note: Replaces UC-503: one row per kept rule in Kept permissions, by kind. A Claude command; a ChatGPT command with its working folder relative to the matter; the one file-edit rule, which covers the whole matter; #1109's per-file read; WebFetch for every page on a host; an MCP server's tool; web search, kept whole

UC-820.en: Allowed this once only: Clauseo keeps "Always" only for one plain command, a site, a tool, or changes to files in this matter.
UC-820.hi: सिर्फ़ इस बार अनुमति दी गई: Clauseo "हमेशा" सिर्फ़ किसी एक सादी कमांड, वेबसाइट, टूल, या इस मामले की फ़ाइलों में बदलाव के लिए रखता है।
UC-820.hi_by: always_core words (provisional; Hindi-speaking lawyer to review)
UC-820.note: Replaces UC-507: thread notice NoticeKind::AlwaysNotKept, reason refused, for either agent. UC-507 said "one exact command, site or file", but a file-edit rule now covers the whole matter and tools and web search can be kept. Keeps the "Allowed this once only:" opening of UC-506, UC-508 and UC-509
